# Chapter 22 finite publication contract

Layer A owns the four complete Chapter22 documents, ART-28 identities, ten metrics, twenty supplied snapshots, eight backlog items, seven statuses and the five teaching contrasts. Syntax/visibility belongs only to shared Publication Projection 1.1.0; action/host grammar belongs only to Content Safety Policy 1.2.0.

## Arithmetic and evidence

`comparison-corpus.json` contains 42 independently authored literal expectations, including count, exact rational proportions, means/medians, nearest-rank p90, zero denominators, missing inputs and malformed/bounded inputs. Expected values are not generated by the evaluator. Member lists are unique subsets with a maximum of 100. Duration samples are integer minutes from 0 through 1,000,000, in the known population-member order; this is a finite teaching range, not a statistical estimation package.

The model fixes the authored purposes, populations, selected members and distinct priority/remedy/acceptance explanations. Refreshing a fixture digest is not editorial approval to homogenize these roles. Verified requires the matching item, metrics, evidence, subject revision, window and cutoff. Accepted has a separate risk owner, scope and expiry; Retired retains old values and replacement metrics. Parent records and authority are never inherited or silently completed.

## Publication selection

Every preamble/body/tail field of all four documents is projected. The Case reading table includes all JSON leaves, including false/null/empty arrays. Reviewed host provenance is a finite exact tuple of document, type, element, attribute, level, text and location with exactly-one cardinality. It covers official Source URLs and literal document/section/version/numeric references misidentified as hosts, not an entire Source Note exemption. Action Policy is never exempted. New host text, movement, duplication or scope expansion requires a fresh review.

## Limits

This is not a Markdown parser, browser emulator, live KPI engine, operational approval system or proof of real risk reduction. No collection, deployment, notification, incident declaration, personal ranking or external target is required. Global Source audit dates, historical parent cases, Policy and formatter pins remain unchanged.

Local entry point: `python3 scripts/check_chapter22_contract.py`. `--no-regressions` still runs all production semantics and publication checks before site generation; it omits only the bounded regression harness. Tests run offline after the pinned dependencies have been provisioned.
